needles: Handing the model its own context as a file to rewrite makes context management model behaviour that a prompt can steer and RL can train. Zero-shot it pays off with a strong model: Qwen3.6-27B on BrowseComp-Plus scores 59.4% against 53.3% for summarisation (+11.4% relative) with 21.5% fewer calculated FLOPs and ties on TerminalBench 2.1, in single runs; with a 9B model it is not the best method. After RL the clear gain is cost (38.8% fewer FLOPs): accuracy is 0.4 points above an equally trained summary harness, and the abstract's +47.6% is against CLM's own untrained start.
